 Three more die of dengue, 1,960 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 481 
 Published : 12 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 12 November 2026, 19:05
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least three dengue patients died and 1,960 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, one each was reported in Dhaka, Barishal and Rajshahi divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the death toll has risen to 481, while the cumulative number of cases has reached 157,628.
 Currently, 5,915 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
